question: On any 4% up-day (four_pct), does lower turnover (illiquidity premium per Asian markets research) beat higher turnover, or does the burst-cohort result (illiquid=worse short-horizon) generalize?
plain: Testing whether low-turnover stocks outperform after any 4% up day, per the illiquidity/size premium literature, or whether liquid stocks still do better as seen in the burst setup.
